bullets: Final-year research project: Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) for Augmented Human Performance, conducted in Distinguished Professor CT Lin's lab — working alongside {{do}} and with support from {{wang}}.
Designed a hidden-target detection experiment in PsychoPy — curating and standardising ~500 images into a six-zone response grid, with timed cue, search, response and confidence-rating phases.
Ran a behavioural pilot with 30 participants and analysed accuracy and reaction times in Python to calibrate task difficulty for the EEG study.
Recorded 64-channel EEG (Neuroscan, Curry 8) with event-marked trials, and built a MATLAB EEGLAB preprocessing pipeline — re-referencing, downsampling and ICA-based ocular artefact removal.
Identified decision-related neural activity peaking ~108 ms before and ~176 ms after participant responses.
